author: cl-slackswitch
body: [opus 5.5] Code landed on main (265db7ed..b5e5e89b): the converted path posts header blocks with a text-only fallback when blocks are refused; the agent label sits on its own paragraph before any opening Markdown block; vibe-talk reads headings as sentences and never ends a thread card on one. Verified live in the #530 slack-outbound-format test thread: the blocks round-trip complete in rich_content. Offline, the reader's shim plus vibe-talk's renderer draw the headings as h2. Open for deployment only: the private vibe-talk Slack shim release that maps header blocks to '## ' headings is staged but not active, and must go live BEFORE the bridge's helper is upgraded, because a blocks post's stored text loses its newlines. After both, check one real reply in vibe-talk. Not verified: the official Slack client's drawing of the header blocks. Slack's header block has no level, so every heading reads as h2.
